thread:
maria_g: Morning all — starting a small canary for feature flag `embed-cache-2` now at 3% in us-east-1. Goal: validate cache hit behavior + no perf regressions. Observability: https://dash.redwood/embeds/canary (p95/p50/error-rate)

deploy-bot: Canary kickoff: feature=embed-cache-2, region=us-east-1, pct=3%, rollout_id=rlt-2026-1765234567

alex_ryan: smoke passed on staging, infra config looks good. I pushed a tiny fix to the health check in PR #4823 — left one comment, non-blocking.

jamal_k: I'll own SRE watch for the next hour. Setting alert thresholds: error-rate > 0.8% over 1m or p95 latency +20% => manual hold.

li_wu: quick metric: p50 +6ms, p95 +28ms on a small sample, cache hit rate ~62% (expected ~65%). Could be sampling noise.

emily_pm: thanks — hold on increasing to 10% until CRM integration job finishes (should be done in ~20m). Please don't escalate yet. :hand:

maria_g: noted. For rollouts: plan is 3% -> 10% -> 30% -> 100% with 20m windows, but we'll stop at any alert. Auto-fallback configured: on X% errors or sustained latency regressed, traffic routed to stable model variant.

jamal_k: FYI I need a short window where we can mute the noisy deployment-alert (flapping during warmup). @maria_g can you approve muting 5m?

maria_g: approved. Mute alerts for 5m while canary ramps. Documenting in the incident/playbook: https://wiki.redwood/rollouts/canary-playbook#embed-cache-2

sre-bot: Alert mute applied by maria_g for 5 minutes (id: mute-1765234578).

alex_ryan: re: PR #4823 — addressed comment about retry backoff. If someone from infra can sanity-check the autoscaling policy (especially burst limit), ping me.

li_wu: after mute, I'm still seeing a small uptick in tail latency for 512-token requests. Breakdown attached (top 3 callers). Not critical but worth watching.

emily_pm: copy. If that persists after 2nd window we pause.

jamal_k: no errors beyond normal yet. I'll keep a 1:1 with the oncall. If anyone sees >1% errors, call it out here immediately.

maria_g: blocker for me: waiting on final signoff from legal for logs retention tweak (affects private deployments) — doesn't block hosted canary but flagging for the next rollout batch.

deploy-bot: Canary update: rollout_id=rlt-2026-1765234567, pct=3% -> stable, errors=0.27%, p95_delta=+18%

maria_g: thanks. Will wait for CRM job + another metric window then bump to 10%. If all clear, target bump ~1765235200 (~10m).

alex_ryan: taking action items: 1) check autoscale burst, 2) follow up on PR comment.

jamal_k: I'll keep watch and post a short summary when we hit 10% or if anything odd.

maria_g: perfect — patience mode for now. Post any urgent findings here. :eyes:
